name: The town boat
nameVi: Bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre
kicker: Morning boat from town into the nipa creeks
summary: Morning boat from the town pier: ride into the nipa creeks for the kiln, a sampan, and lunch. You leave bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre, watch candy made, mix honey tea, and hear đờn ca tài tử. Cồn Phụng is a separate landing. Skip this pier when the nine-dragon court is the only stop you wanted.
getThere: Walk to bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre, then the boat.
heroCaption: A tourist boat on the Ben Tre River, along the bank

notice.title: Cồn Phụng is a separate landing
notice.body: This boat leaves the town pier. The islet is about 10–12 km by road, or 25 km by river. The Friday town cart stays in town.

body: Leave bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre and ride the river into the nipa creeks. The morning stops at a coconut-candy kiln for a warm piece, honey tea you mix yourself, and fruit in season. On the water you can sit for đờn ca tài tử, take a sampan through a small creek, and ride a xe lôi along the village road.

Lunch is under the palms. The clock and the fare are Check on arrival. Give the outing the morning. A sunset cruise picks up at Bến tàu du lịch Hùng Vương. That name is a second dock. Use it for the cruise you booked.

figures.caption: Tourist boats tied along the bank, with palms behind them
figures.alt: Canopy tourist boats moored on the Ben Tre River, coconut palms on the bank

gettingThere: The morning boat leaves bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre. From a room on the town bank, walk to the pier and go in the morning.
Cồn Phụng is the longer islet, about 10–12 km by road or 25 km by river, from its own landing. The Friday seven-seat cart stays on the town streets.

legs.heading: From the town bank
legs.body: Walk to bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre and take the morning boat. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From a sunset cruise
legs.body: Du thuyền Hạ Thảo picks up at Bến tàu du lịch Hùng Vương. Book that cruise on its own. It is a second name beside the morning pier.

closed: Check on arrival. The town day puts the boat in the morning.
admissionNote: The boat fare is Check on arrival. A sampan and a xe lôi are part of the same morning. Whether they sit inside one fare is Check on arrival.
